import json,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
import feedback
writer=feedback.DB_PATH
reader=feedback.resolve_db_path()
assert writer.expanduser().resolve()==reader, (writer,reader)
expected=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
assert reader==expected,(reader,expected)
api=feedback.resolve_db_path(state_dir=Path(sys.argv[2]))
assert api==Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve(),(api,sys.argv[3])
assert feedback.resolve_db_path(Path(sys.argv[4]))==Path(sys.argv[4]).resolve()
print(json.dumps(dict(writer=str(writer),reader=str(reader),api_fallback=str(api),explicit_winner=sys.argv[4])))
